# Contributing

> 🌐 Language / Ngôn ngữ: **English** | [Tiếng Việt](CONTRIBUTING.vi.md)

All participants must follow our [Code of Conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) ([Tiếng Việt](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.vi.md)). For conduct concerns, use the private reporting route described there; report software vulnerabilities using the separate [Security Policy](SECURITY.md).

Please review the bilingual README, API documentation, and security guides before contributing. Preserve model-specific settings and licenses. Run the CPU test suite and Ruff lint before submitting changes. Use the pull request template; keep sensitive data out of commits. After changing source files, run `python scripts/verify_source_checksums.py --write` and `python scripts/verify_source_checksums.py --check`. Review model runtime compatibility and dependency licenses before upgrading packages.
